Title: Students courseId query param
Steps: 1. Call contentApi.listStudents with no argument 2. Call it with an empty string 3. Call it with a selected course id
Expected: GET /api/v1/courses/students is issued with params.courseId exactly equal to the argument in all three cases

Title: Students response is a bare array
PreConditions: content-service does not wrap responses in ApiEnvelope
Steps: Call contentApi.listStudents() and inspect the resolved value
TestData: One StudentEnrollment row (status completed and progressPercent 100)
Expected: The resolved value is the row array unchanged because no envelope is stripped

Title: Students 403 error mapping
PreConditions: The caller is not an instructor
Expected: Rejects with an ApiError whose status is 403 and message is 'Forbidden'

Title: Students empty list
Steps: Call contentApi.listStudents() and inspect the resolved value
Expected: Resolves to an empty array unchanged which drives the StudentsPage empty state

Title: Course filter params
Steps: Call contentApi.listCourses({mine:true;perPage:100}) and inspect the wire params
Expected: GET /api/v1/courses is issued with mine=true and per_page=100 and the camelCase key perPage is absent from the wire params

Title: Course filter with mine false
Steps: Call contentApi.listCourses({mine:false}) and inspect the wire params
Expected: The mine key is omitted from the query params so the backend returns all courses

Title: Stat card derivation
PreConditions: Instructor seeded in the auth store; listStudents and listCourses mocked at the module boundary
Steps: Render StudentsPage and wait for the 3 student rows
Expected: The three stat cards read total=3 and completed=1 and average progress='58%' because Math.round(175/3) is 58

Title: Stat cards with no students
PreConditions: Instructor seeded; listStudents returns an empty list
Steps: Render StudentsPage and wait for the empty-state copy
Expected: The stat cards read total=0 and completed=0 and average progress='0%' via the explicit zero branch (never NaN) and the 'Chua co hoc vien nao ghi danh.' empty state is shown

Title: Student table and course filter
PreConditions: Instructor seeded; 2 students returned and one of them has a null name
Steps: Render StudentsPage and wait for 2 rows then assert the row contents and the select options
TestData: 1 student named 'Student en-1' and 1 student with studentName=null and studentEmail=null
Expected: Two instructor-students-row elements render; the named student appears; the null name falls back to 'Khong co ten'; the course select offers 'Tat ca khoa hoc cua toi' plus one option per course

Title: Students error state
Steps: Render StudentsPage and wait for the error copy
Expected: The 'Khong tai duoc du lieu. Thu lai sau.' message renders and no instructor-students-rows table is rendered

Title: Students route and guard and testids and stat sanity
PreConditions: Dev server on :3000; valid instructor storageState; both reads intercepted with page.route
Steps: 1. Open /instructor/students 2. Assert the URL is unchanged 3. Assert the data-testids and row count 4. Assert the derived stat values 5. Assert zero console errors
TestData: 3 students (100 completed and 50 active and 25 active)
Expected: URL stays /instructor/students so the instructor guard passes; instructor-students-stats / -course-filter / -rows / -row are present; 3 rows render; the null-name student shows the 'Khong co ten' fallback; total=3 and completed=1 and average=58%; zero console errors
